metadata.title: British Columbia government atlas — research companion
metadata.scope: Selected official-source research for the proposed historical government interface
metadata.integration_note: Local subject keys are proposed identifiers, not IDs from the user’s project. Review and map before import.
metadata.coverage_note: The user’s reported 242 ministry episodes, 1,236 ministerial terms and other totals were not comprehensively audited.
metadata.asset_note: No corporate logo masters, font files or original source documents are included.

tasks.title: Reconcile Lieutenant Governors count
tasks.completion_criteria: Compare all 32 local records against the official 31-person sequence; retain administrators or separate terms under explicit categories.
tasks.notes: Do not delete a record solely because counts differ.

tasks.title: Add typed dates instead of one founding year
tasks.interface_value: Allows historical organizations to appear without pretending current names existed earlier.
tasks.completion_criteria: Store function origin, legal creation, operational start, name adoption and brand adoption separately; map the seed events to reviewed local IDs.

tasks.title: Distinguish direct, accountable and partner relationships
tasks.interface_value: Prevents an attractive but false organizational tree.
tasks.completion_criteria: Add typed relationship intervals and a lane for bodies whose responsible ministry is unknown.

tasks.title: Prepare the 2026 election update pipeline
tasks.interface_value: Supports called, preliminary, final and post-election government states.
tasks.completion_criteria: Import official milestones now; ingest results only when published; record actual cabinet appointments independently.
tasks.notes: This pack creates no scheduled job or background monitoring.

tasks.title: Acquire the five priority corporate logo families
tasks.interface_value: Adds recognizable identity without approximate redrawing.
tasks.completion_criteria: Obtain originals, rights/conditions, variant names, provenance, adoption/observation dates and visual comparison results.
tasks.notes: No font files are included or redistributed.

tasks.title: Historical sub-agencies: begin with organizations users will open
tasks.completion_criteria: Research each selected unit’s first/last attestation, predecessor and parent intervals; distinguish unknown dates from confirmed inactivity.

tasks.title: BC Rail responsible-minister intervals, 1972–2003
tasks.interface_value: Resolves a long, high-visibility orphan period.
tasks.completion_criteria: For each interval, retrieve contemporaneous report transmittal/governance evidence or a legal assignment; record exact relation and bounds.
tasks.notes: Current transport affiliation is not evidence for all earlier years. This interval remains unresolved.

tasks.title: WCB responsible-minister intervals, 1917–1974
tasks.completion_criteria: Identify reports and instruments; distinguish minister tabling a report, statutory accountability and operational control.
tasks.notes: No continuous ministry assignment has been established here.

tasks.title: Pre-1905 agency discovery by report series
tasks.interface_value: Targets many missing periods from a small set of historical sources.
tasks.completion_criteria: Use indexes to locate reports; read original pages; create sourced period claims with report year and publication year separated.

tasks.title: MLAs, ridings and by-elections
tasks.completion_criteria: Link people to elected service episodes and contemporaneous districts; record vacancies, by-elections, affiliations and party changes separately.
tasks.notes: Plan for historical multi-member districts; verify voting rules per election before applying a modern seat model.

tasks.title: Parliament, sessions and committee memberships
tasks.interface_value: Enables legislative rather than merely election-night history.
tasks.completion_criteria: Use Assembly records to create Parliament/session records, committee mandates and dated memberships; do not extrapolate from current listings.

tasks.title: Historical deputy ministers and executives
tasks.interface_value: Replaces present-only people cards with timelines.
tasks.completion_criteria: Obtain appointment instruments or dated official rosters; represent report attestations as observations when term boundaries are unknown.
tasks.notes: No ready-made comprehensive deputy list was verified.

tasks.title: Historical staffing and spending
tasks.interface_value: Adds scale to organization cards and comparisons.
tasks.completion_criteria: Extract fiscal-period measures with unit, budget/actual basis, consolidated scope and source page; preserve reorganization comparability flags.

tasks.title: Resolve government identity chronology
tasks.completion_criteria: Locate dated identity manuals, directives or original applications; separate symbol grant, program issue, first observation and documented retirement.
tasks.notes: Earlier 1977/1982 manual leads from the project should be reconciled with catalogue records and scans, not treated as newly verified adoption dates.

tasks.title: Include connected public institutions as optional layers
tasks.interface_value: Lets users explore beyond core government without implying ownership.
tasks.completion_criteria: Decide rules for TransLink, post-2003 BC Ferries, universities/colleges, school boards and municipalities; assign legal/governance types before drawing links.
tasks.notes: A scope choice is not a research finding. Keep First Nations governance distinct.

tasks.title: Reconcile counts and coverage denominators
tasks.interface_value: Makes coverage indicators intelligible and trustworthy.
tasks.completion_criteria: Define unique bodies versus episodes, unique people versus terms, overlapping sub-agency classes, and duration-weighted versus sampled-year coverage.
tasks.notes: User-reported subcategory counts may overlap; do not infer an error from approximate totals alone.

tasks.title: Visual identity export verification
tasks.interface_value: Separates archival evidence, reconstruction fidelity and permitted use.
tasks.completion_criteria: For each preset, retain source application and a rendered comparison; classify original/vector-derived/reconstructed/synthetic and record font substitutions.
tasks.notes: Government symbols and font files need their own rights treatment. No export-overlay test of the user’s generator was performed here.
